assignments.question: Write the DASH (expanded structural) formula and the CONDENSED formula for the following compounds. [official A1 lists C2H6 (ethane); the dash/condensed set continues into A2]

assignments.topic: Degree (1/2/3/4) of C & H atoms; degree of alcohols, amines, halides
assignments.question: (a) Identify the degree of the C and H atoms in the given structures (table: count 1C,2C,3C,4C and 1H,2H,3H). (b) Identify the degree of the given alcohols (i-iv). (c) Identify the degree of the amines (i-iv). (d) Identify the degree of the halides (i-iv).
(i-iii) Identify the functional group(s) present in each given molecule. Then: count the number of DIFFERENT functional groups in the final multi-group molecule.

IUPAC naming set. Confirmed questions: Q1 IUPAC name & structure of CH3CHO. Q2 IUPAC name of CH3-O-C2H5. Q3 name the structure with OH (3,3-dimethylcyclohexanol). Q4 select correct IUPAC name (heptane MCQ). Q5 IUPAC name of acetylsalicylic acid. Q6 dienes: terms for compounds with [cumulated/conjugated/isolated] double bonds. Q7 smallest alkane that can form a ring. Q8 select correct IUPAC name of neopentane (MCQ). Q9 name the compound (1,2-epoxypropane). Q10 formula of ethanol. Q11 order of priority of functional groups. Q12 what is a functional group. Q13 examples of functional groups with formula. Q14 3-bromo-1-chlorocyclohexene (name/structure). Q15 draw structures: salicylic acid, neopentane, o-xylene, toluene, acetone, diethyl ether. PLUS: rules of IUPAC nomenclature; name 4-bromo-3-methylpent-2-ene; name 4-propyl-3,5-dimethylhept-1-en-6-yne; IUPAC name of CH3C≡N (acetonitrile); IUPAC name of CH3COOC2H5 (ethyl acetate).
Find the number of sigma and pi bonds in the following compounds: (i) H-C≡C-H, (ii) cyclopropane, (iii) N≡C-C≡N, (iv) benzene [confirm exact 4th structure from the sheet].

Q1 What is isomerism in organic chemistry? Q2 What is threo and erythro? Plus classify isomerism: structural (chain, position, functional) and stereo (geometrical cis/trans & E/Z, optical) with examples.
Explain the types of hybridisation (sp, sp2, sp3) with examples. Differentiate between homolytic and heterolytic fission.
Differentiate (in a table): Inductive effect vs Resonance/Mesomeric effect vs Electromeric effect vs Hyperconjugation — definition, permanence, mechanism, example.

Differentiate between carbocation, carbanion and free radical (charge, electrons, hybridisation, geometry, role). Explain their stability (inductive, hyperconjugation, resonance). Differentiate homolytic vs heterolytic fission. Explain a carbonium-ion reaction.

Q1 Explain the stability of a carbanion with respect to inductive effect, resonance, and alkyl/benzyl. Q2 Explain the stability of a free radical with respect to inductive effect, resonance, and alkyl/benzyl.
Distinguish between SN1 and SN2 reactions (rate law, order, steps, carbocation, rearrangement, substrate preference, stereochemistry, examples).
Difference between E1 and E2 (molecularity, steps, carbocation, rearrangement, base, rate dependence, Zaitsev/Hofmann, substrate, examples).
